Tether Whip

Snap the lightning conduit to yank your tethered victim up to 1.5m toward the chosen ground location. Kinetic Collision: If the victim slams into a wall, obstacle, or another creature, both take 1d4 Bludgeoning damage. Target must be Small or Medium. Ground-targeted only; cannot target chasms or mid-air. Free Action (Once per Turn).

Snap the surging conduit to violently throw your tethered victim up to 3m toward the chosen ground location. Kinetic Collision: If the victim slams into a wall, obstacle, or another creature, both take 1d6 Bludgeoning damage and must pass a Strength Saving Throw or fall Prone. Affects up to Large creatures. Ground-targeted only; cannot target chasms or mid-air. Free Action (Once per Turn).

Snap the tempestuous conduit to catapult your tethered victim up to 4.5m toward the chosen ground location. Kinetic Collision: If the victim slams into a wall, obstacle, or another creature, both take 2d6 Bludgeoning damage and must pass a Strength Saving Throw or fall Prone. Affects up to Huge creatures. Ground-targeted only; cannot target chasms or mid-air. Free Action (Once per Turn).
Witch Bolt (Tethered)
Tethered by a crackling conduit of lightning. The tether automatically shocks you each turn for lightning damage.
Channeling: Witch Bolt

Maintaining a lightning conduit to your tethered victim. The tether automatically deals 1d12 Lightning damage at the start of each turn. Kinetically reposition them up to 1.5m with Tether Whip.
Channel: Occupies your Channel slot. Subject to damage saving throws; does not conflict with an active Focus spell. Casting Cantrips, Bonus Action spells, or Quickened spells does not break Channel.
Channeling: Witch Bolt (Surging)

Maintaining an upcast lightning conduit. The tether automatically deals 3d12 Lightning damage at the start of each turn. Kinetically throw them up to 3m with Tether Whip.
Channel: Occupies your Channel slot. Subject to damage saving throws; does not conflict with an active Focus spell. Casting Cantrips, Bonus Action spells, or Quickened spells does not break Channel.
Channeling: Witch Bolt (Tempest)

Maintaining a tempestuous lightning conduit. The tether automatically deals 5d12 Lightning damage at the start of each turn. Kinetically catapult them up to 4.5m with Tether Whip.
Channel: Occupies your Channel slot. Subject to damage saving throws; does not conflict with an active Focus spell. Casting Cantrips, Bonus Action spells, or Quickened spells does not break Channel.
Tether Charged
Your lightning conduit has reached full resonance. You can use Tether Whip to kinetically reposition your victim up to 1.5m as a Free Action once per turn.
Tether Charged (Surging)
Your upcast conduit has reached full resonance. You can use Tether Whip to violently throw your victim up to 3m as a Free Action once per turn.
Tether Stabilizing
The electric conduit is stabilizing and cannot be used for Tether Whip until your next turn.
